name: zfmv_action_fade_end
description: zFMV_ActionFade::End releases a captured frame when present and clears the captured-frame slot.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zFMV fade action/source-file pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x463550 validates the MSVC thiscall End hook: load capturedFrame from offset 32, skip work when it is null, call zVid_Image::ReleaseIfNotDefault for a non-null captured frame, clear capturedFrame to null, and return without a value.
The dependency frontier has no visible source blockers; zVid_Image::ReleaseIfNotDefault is accepted functional and tier S.
The native smoke verifies that null capturedFrame does not call the release helper and that a non-null capturedFrame is passed to the release helper and then cleared.
